original language:
Ziyarat of
Imam Jaffer al Sadiq (AS)

translation: Peace Be On You, O Imam Of The World!
Peace Be On You O Secure And Lasting Link Of Allah!

original language: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يا حَبْلَ اللهِ المَتِيْنِ
translation: Peace Be On You, O Strong Rope Of  Allah!

original language: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يا نُوْرَ اللهِ المُبِينِ
translation: Peace Be On You, O The Bright Light Of Allah!
Peace Be On You, O The Truthful

original language: جَعْفَرُ اَبْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ خازِنُ العِلْمِ اَلداعِي
translation: Ja’Far Son Of Mohammad, Treasurer Of Allah’S Knowledge,
O True Inviter Of People Towards Allah!

original language: اللّهُمَ كَمْا جَعَلْتَهُ مَعْدَنَ كَلامِكَ وَ وَحْيِكَ وَ خَازِنَ عِلْمِكَ
translation: O Allah! In The Same Way As You Have Made Him The Mine Of Your Words And Of Your Messages And The Treasurer Of Your Knowledge,

original language: وَ لِسانَ تَوْحِيدِكَ وَ وَليَّ أمْرِكَ
translation: And Give Him The Language Of Your Oneness, The Ownership Of Your Realm

original language: وَ مُسْتَحْفِظَ دِيْنِكَ, وَ صلِ عَلْيِهِ أفْضَلَ
translation: And The Protectorship Of Your Religion, Send The Choicest Of Blessings On Him-

original language: ما صَلَّيْتَ عَلْى أحَدٍ مِنْ أصْفْيائِكَ
translation: The Same Blessings Bestowed By You On Your Regents And Successors.
Surely, You Are Worthy Of Praise And Your Are Revered!
